name: scriba
//scribaPins: scribaPins records the Angular, NestJS and Zod majors and the TypeScript line. PLT-01 installs none of the three packages; PLT-02, PLT-03 and PLT-04 install them at these majors. If the newest Angular major's build tooling excludes the TypeScript line, implementation stops and records the conflict for the Navigator. Neither pin is changed silently.
